δόξα, -ης, ἡ 
(δοκέω), [in LXX very frequently for כָּבוֹד, also for הוֹד ,פִּפְאֶרֶת, etc., 25 words in all ;] 
in cl., 
__1. expectation, judgment, opinion (4Ma.5.18). 
__2. opinion, estimation in which one is held, repute; in NT, always good opinion, hence reputation, praise, honour, glory: Luk.14.10, Jhn.12.43, Heb.3.3; opposite to αἰσχύνη, Php.3.19 to ἀτιμία, 2Co.6.8 δ. κ. τιμή, Rom.2.7, 10 1Pe.1.7, 2Pe.1.17; ζητεῖν, Jhn.5.44; 7.18; 8.50, 1Th.2.6; λαμβάνειν, Jhn.5.41, 2Pe.1.17, Rev.5.12; διδόναι δ. τ. θεῷ (cf. נָתַן כָּבוֹד לַיהוָֹה, Jer.13.16, al.), Luk.17.18, Jhn.9.24, Act.12.23, Rom.4.20, Rev.4.9; εἰς (τ.) δ. θεοῦ, Rom.3.7; 15.7, Php.1.11, al.; in doxologies, τ. θεῷ (ᾧ) ἡ δ.,…
